Daily Table per Pig

Source: R/monitor_pigs.R
monitor_pigs.Rd

One row per pig and day, from the first day the pig was seen (or the start of the window) to the last day of the window. A day without any visit is kept with status = "no_visit", so a pig that stopped eating is never missing from the table.

monitor_pigs(
  data,
  days = 7,
  end_date = NULL,
  low_feed_kg = 0.5,
  station = NULL,
  verbose = 1
)

Arguments

data

Station data: a folder or files of NEDAP or FIRE exports (read with read_station()), a raw export already in R such as tidypptsda::nedap, or the result of read_station() or prep_visits().

days

Number of days in the window, ending on end_date. Default 7.

end_date

Last day of the window (a Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"). Default NULL: the last day in the data, or yesterday when the last day is today (an export taken during the day is incomplete).

low_feed_kg

A pig that ate less than this on a day (kg) is "low_feed". Default 0.5.

station

"nedap", "fire" or NULL (detect), passed to read_station() and prep_visits().

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

Value

A data.table with one row per pig (responder) and date, for the pigs with at least one identified visit in the window:

  • location: the station where the pig had most visits in the window;

  • n_visits, feed_kg, occupation_min (minutes), weight_kg (median body weight of the day);

  • status: "no_visit", "low_feed" (less than low_feed_kg) or "ok".

See also

run_monitor(), whose pig_summary sums this table up per pig.

Examples

pigs <- monitor_pigs(tidypptsda::fire, days = 7, verbose = 0)
pigs[status != "ok"]
#>    location responder       date n_visits feed_kg occupation_min weight_kg
#>      <char>    <char>     <Date>    <int>   <num>          <num>     <num>
#> 1:      102     35857 2024-02-22        2  -0.012            7.8     118.4
#> 2:      102     35860 2024-02-22        4   0.006            5.6     122.8
#> 3:      102     35861 2024-02-22        4   0.096           12.3     137.2
#> 4:      102     35882 2024-02-22        4   0.300            8.9     131.7
#> 5:      102     35883 2024-02-22        2   0.004            0.5        NA
#>      status
#>      <char>
#> 1: low_feed
#> 2: low_feed
#> 3: low_feed
#> 4: low_feed
#> 5: low_feed
wide_table(pigs, "feed_kg")
